project_description: Introduce a protocol-neutral, authoritative A-leg mechanism for complete conversation messages that must remain visible in client/session history but never be forwarded on inference B-legs. Persist replay-stable semantic message identities with bounded memory and SQLite/PostgreSQL continuity, derive an early backend-effective call that removes tagged history before routing/context/billing work, re-enforce the invariant at the shared final PTB/backend-open boundary, and add a generic two-phase local-turn extension seam that protects claimed input before local handling and protects a proxy-generated assistant reply before client release. Keep CTP/A-leg truth and continuation history intact, use existing canonical EventStream/frontend encoding, preserve base continuity/canonical contracts, and implement no interactive command grammar/handlers, routing-setting commands, or concrete quota-notification policy in this spec.
